name: aevum-tooling
description: The outer repo's single code home: mirrors each lane's public docs, resolves the product-topic index, keeps the generated doc regions fresh, merges the per-lane stats into aevum-stats.json + METRICS.md, syncs the README brand block, and builds user_manual.pdf from the T0 docs in docs/public.

scripts.check: npm run features:check && npm run links && npm test && npm run public:check && npm run outer:check && npm run docs:map:check
scripts.build: npm run sync-branding && npm run sync-readme && npm run stats && npm run docs && npm run docs:map && npm run public && npm run outer
